entries.title: Proverbs 12:1
segments: ¶Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge, But he who hates correction [is] stupid.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:2
segments: ¶A good [man] obtains favor from the LORD, But a man of wicked intentions He will condemn.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:3
segments: ¶A man is not established by wickedness, But the root of the righteous cannot be moved.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:4
segments: ¶An excellent wife [is] the crown of her husband, But she who causes shame [is] like rottenness in his bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:5
segments: ¶The thoughts of the righteous [are] right, [But] the counsels of the wicked [are] deceitful.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:6
segments: ¶The words of the wicked [are], "Lie in wait for blood," But the mouth of the upright will deliver them.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:7
segments: ¶The wicked are overthrown and [are] no more, But the house of the righteous will stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:8
segments: ¶A man will be commended according to his wisdom, But he who is of a perverse heart will be despised.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:9
segments: ¶Better [is the one] who is slighted but has a servant, Than he who honors himself but lacks bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:10
segments: ¶A righteous [man] regards the life of his animal, But the tender mercies of the wicked [are] cruel.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:11
segments: ¶He who tills his land will be satisfied with bread, But he who follows frivolity [is] devoid of understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:12
segments: ¶The wicked covet the catch of evil [men], But the root of the righteous yields [fruit].

entries.title: Proverbs 12:13
segments: ¶The wicked is ensnared by the transgression of [his] lips, But the righteous will come through trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:14
segments: ¶A man will be satisifed with good by the fruit of [his] mouth, And the recompense of a man's hands will be rendered to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:15
segments: ¶The way of a fool [is] right in his own eyes, But he who heeds counsel [is] wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:16
segments: ¶A fool's wrath is known at once, But a prudent [man] covers shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:17
segments: ¶He [who] speaks truth declares righteousness, But a false witness, deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:18
segments: ¶There is one who speaks like the piercings of a sword, But the tongue of the wise [promotes] health.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:19
segments: ¶The truthful lip shall be established forever, But a lying tongue [is] but for a moment.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:20
segments: ¶Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, But counselors of peace have joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:21
segments: ¶No grave trouble will overtake the righteous, But the wicked shall be filled with evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:22
segments: ¶Lying lips [are] an abomination to the LORD, But those who deal truthfully [are] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:23
segments: ¶A prudent man conceals knowledge, But the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:24
segments: ¶The hand of the diligent will rule, But the lazy [man] will be put to forced labor.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:25
segments: ¶Anxiety in the heart of man causes depression, But a good word makes it glad.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:26
segments: ¶The righteous should choose his friends carefully, For the way of the wicked leads them astray.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:27
segments: ¶The lazy [man] does not roast what he took in hunting, But diligence [is] man's precious possession.

entries.title: Proverbs 12:28
segments: ¶In the way of righteousness [is] life, And in [its] pathway [there is] no death.
